name: Navigation/Global
purpose: Render Aurora's persistent global application navigation in its approved expanded and collapsed compositions.

navigationContent.composition: Dedicated 48x48 Navigation icon frames; do not approximate by merely hiding labels from the expanded variant.

tokenRules: Preserve Figma-bound Aurora semantic variables for background, foreground, text and state colors.
Do not replace token bindings with visually similar hard-coded values when token references are available.
behaviorBoundary: This component contract defines approved visual structure and variants, not routing, permission logic, persistence or responsive transformation rules.

must: Use one of the two approved Expanded variants.
Reuse approved Aurora icons and Gestor logo.
Use Navigation/Item and Navigation/Group contracts for navigation content.
mustNot: Replace Aurora icons with letters, emoji or generic substitutes.
Invent a separate Omnilink header inside this component.
Remove Brand, Search or Utilities from Expanded=True without explicit product evidence.
Treat Expanded=False as Expanded=True with CSS-hidden labels only.
Approximate missing visual information; stop and declare the gap instead.
